notablePrerequisites: You control three creatures that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Activate Nicol Bolas using Dovin's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using at least three creatures, triggering Nicol Bolas that many times, putting that many loyalty counters on it.
Activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
During your next turn, activate Nicol Bolas using Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Nicol Bolas, causing it to re-enter the battlefield with four loyalty counters on it.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 once.
Repeat from step 1 during your next turn.

uses.name: Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God
uses.cardState: with seven or more loyalty counters
